purpose: Expand related sections while preserving independent item identity and a typed array of expanded values.
avoid: Do not conceal information every reader must compare.
basis: Native source page 72:2591 (Accordion), observed anatomy and examples.
profileRationale: The family presents controls or navigation; static depictions do not establish an interactive contract.
sourceRule: multiple=false permits at most one expanded item; pressing that item closes it. multiple=true toggles items independently. Disabled root/items suppress changes. The callback candidate may be canceled; controlled value stays prop-authoritative.
keyboardAndFocus: Base UI 1.9 uses normal Tab order and native Enter/Space on each trigger. Its orientation/loopFocus props are deprecated and no longer implement roving/arrow focus. Arrow/Home/End are not invented as accordion selection commands.
referenceDecisions: One stable trigger/content ownership relation per shown instance; concrete labels and task children are caller supplied. Exact wrapper types retain optional handles/payloads/placement overrides. Complete describes this sufficient reference, not a full application/platform certification.
